discussion-development.title: Turn discussion into development
discussion-development.intro: Review the assistant reply and development instructions, then choose a tool and its current model configuration. Create a plan before separately confirming execution.
discussion-development.goal_hint: Up to 8,000 UTF-8 bytes. Review and edit the instructions before continuing.
discussion-development.criteria_hint: One per line, up to 32. These do not replace the task's formal acceptance criteria or published tests.
discussion-development.copy_task_criteri: Use the task's existing criteria as plan reference
discussion-development.tools_hint: Options follow current dispatch conditions. Selecting a tool does not start execution.
discussion-development.selection_codex: Explicitly choose a model and reasoning effort from the current Codex catalog. Usage is observed; a provider hard budget cap is not guaranteed.
discussion-development.selection_platfor: Choose a fresh platform model, call limits and budget for this development plan. Formal execution limits remain in effect.
discussion-development.selection_fixed: The tool controls its own model configuration. It does not inherit the discussion reply's model or budget. Review any configuration facts provided below.
discussion-development.select_tool: Choose an agent from current dispatch options
discussion-development.no_tool: No eligible writable development tool appears on this page. Check the next page or inspect tool configuration and unavailability reasons.
discussion-development.page: {{loaded}} options shown · {{total}} in the current catalog
discussion-development.consent: I reviewed the development instructions, supplementary checks and the selected tool's model configuration and limits.
discussion-development.boundary: The plan retains the original task and reply. Development, independent tests and human acceptance still use their original gates.
discussion-development.review_start: I reviewed the fixed workflow, tool, model configuration, applicable budget limits and original task context.
discussion-development.started: Development started in the original execution
discussion-development.pending: The original request may already have been accepted. Check the same request before creating another plan or starting again.
discussion-development.access: Access changed. Protected plan details are hidden; the original request is preserved.
discussion-development.not_ready: Use a completed reply with current task and discussion context. Refresh the original reply after changes.
discussion-development.invalid_read: The development plan response could not be verified. Refresh its original task context.
discussion-development.native_only: Choose a writable development tool eligible for current formal dispatch and its applicable model configuration.
discussion-development.start_separate: Creating this plan does not run code. Starting it is a separate explicit action.
